scope: 260 unchanged curated-reference atlas-space SWCs in exact prepared-manifest order
counting_recipe: Parse original seven-field source rows without graph modification. A reconstruction leaf is a node ID absent from all parent IDs. Strict axonal reconstruction leaves additionally require source node type2. Node/leaf types0 and10 remain unresolved. All bound files rehash after reading.

source_code_references.meaning: All zero-child graph nodes become terminal_nodes; no compartment or biological-end filter.
Tracer stores id/type/XYZ/radius/parent, without biological terminal status.
Every graph leaf receives nearest-voxel atlas region; unknown/outside leaves are retained.
Terminal_Regions is deduplicated by region; Terminal_Count counts unique regions, not leaf nodes.
Terminal_Sites exports unique target regions and side labels, not individual endpoint identities.
Hierarchy resolves then deduplicates parent regions; endpoint multiplicity is not conserved.
Structural parser preserves custom types; only seven standard fields drive traversal and completeness is not inferred.
Viewer identifies dendrite type3 and non-type3 axon-root edge; this differs from strict type2 selection.
Viewer axon rendering skips type3 edges and retains other types; custom-type semantics remain unconfirmed.

legacy_export_semantics.Terminal_Count: unique atlas region labels containing at least one graph leaf of any node type
legacy_export_semantics.Terminal_Sites: one row per unique per-neuron region, not one row per endpoint
legacy_export_semantics.laterality_counts: unique target-region entries; not endpoint counts
legacy_export_semantics.hierarchy: unique parent-region presence; not summed leaf counts

biological_terminal_or_bouton_verificati: not established; topology/type alone cannot distinguish true endings, truncated traces, weak-signal stops or synaptic boutons
truncation_and_proximal_policy: legacy leaf selection has no cut-end flag, image-boundary/tracing-gap test, soma-distance threshold or terminal-branch-length exclusion

cached_server_property_sample.scope: one existing cached server-property sample outside the curated260; no server reads
cached_server_property_sample.biological_annotation_status: Aggregate terminal-region/endcount metadata exists; this sample has no per-node bouton/truncation-confidence field.
